name: yearly
sqlTemplate:
-- ============================================================================
-- 单品销售年度汇总（ss_item_sk = 1）
-- 业务范围：仅统计商品主键 ss_item_sk = 1 的单品门店销售记录
-- 说明：上一版全表年度汇总超出 10 秒执行预算，本版通过将 ss_item_sk 等值
--       过滤（复合主键前缀）大幅缩小扫描范围，满足性能要求。
-- 统计指标：销售行数、数量合计、净收款合计、净利润合计、最早/最晚销售日期
-- 关联维度：date_dim（通过 ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk）
-- 分组粒度：按自然年（d_year）升序，至多返回 10 行
-- 无参数可复用 SQL；本文件仅供审查，不执行、不捏造结果。
-- ============================================================================

SELECT
    d.d_year                                            AS sales_year,
    COUNT(*)                                            AS sales_rows,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity)                                 AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                                 AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)                               AS total_net_profit,
    MIN(d.d_date)                                       AS earliest_date,
    MAX(d.d_date)                                       AS latest_date
FROM store_sales  ss
INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = 1          -- 复合主键前缀等值过滤，缩小扫描范围
GROUP BY d.d_year
ORDER BY sales_year ASC
LIMIT 10;

name: monthly
sqlTemplate:
-- tpcds monthly sales summary for a specific item
-- Database: tpcds (test env 248)
-- Placeholders (unquoted, substituted by template engine):
--   {{product_id}}   – integer, ss_item_sk value (required)
--   {{start_date}}   – date literal, inclusive start
--   {{end_date}}     – date literal, inclusive end
--   {{min_quantity}} – integer, minimum ss_quantity per row
--   {{category}}     – string literal or NULL; NULL skips the category filter

SELECT
    d.d_year                           AS sale_year,
    d.d_moy                            AS sale_month,
    i.i_category                       AS category,
    COUNT(*)                           AS row_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity)                AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)              AS total_net_profit
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
INNER JOIN tpcds.date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN tpcds.item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = {{product_id}}
  AND d.d_date >= {{start_date}}
  AND d.d_date <= {{end_date}}
  AND ss.ss_quantity >= {{min_quantity}}
  AND ({{category}} IS NULL OR i.i_category = {{category}})
GROUP BY d.d_year,
         d.d_moy,
         i.i_category
ORDER BY d.d_year ASC,
         d.d_moy ASC,
         i.i_category ASC
LIMIT 24;
title: TPCDS 248 单品期间月度销售分析验收
description: 指定商品、起止日期、最低购买数量及可选品类的真实门店逐月销售、数量、净收款及利润，默认商品1，NULL品类不过滤。
